content.comment_body: Requesting assistance: I need to transfer the UP/DOWN counter output to trigger the analog threshold. The simulation works well, but this does not happen in online mode. Thanks for any help [user_name]
Please upload your program as a ZIP file. The screenshot provided isn't very helpful.
Thank you for offering help. Here is the file.

Hello [user_name], I believe your issue relates to the cursor function. Are you aware that a specific screen is necessary to use the arrow cursor button? The relevant button is marked as 'cursor keys' in the image. Replace the cursor key input with an actual input and display the counter value somewhere to test the concept once more.
Hello #dP. The counter value increases but is not activating the trigger. This happens in the simulation but not with the actual hardware.
What exactly is not working from your perspective? On my device, the programmed logic operates without problems.
My device does not transfer B001 CNT to B002 ON; simulation works, but uploading to the actual hardware does not.
This is just one function that's not working for me in a larger project.
On my device, the program behaves exactly as programmed. Let me ask again: Why do you think it isn't working?

The issue is not with transferring the counter value in my assessment. You must be in a special screen, as indicated by the red block in the earlier attached image. The simulation allows triggering with the arrow key easily, but on actual hardware, the arrow key only works in a specific screen when pressing 'ESC' and the arrow key together. Try displaying the counter value directly and test this with the real device.
@ #dP, I stated that the program operates exactly as the user programmed. There are no errors; it works correctly.
I am not sure what mistake I am making. Maybe a screenshot would help clarify.
I tested it on two new units with the latest firmware.

You should not compare the online view with the simulation view. The values in the fields below each block are for simulation and parameterization only. Refer to your online screenshot; the red boxes show the real values for each block. Since the analog input is only set to 1, the threshold switch cannot activate.

Tomorrow I will try using a connected analog signal. I just need to change the threshold switch in block B002 via the cursor key on the LCD bar graph. I prefer not to enter a numeric value directly in block B002 before editing the program. Thank you again for your help.
Do you want the counter to only count up, not down?

Yes, my project involves both UP and DOWN counting. This example doesn't work for me, but my larger project is included as an attachment. The project manages ventilation window opening in a factory, where the wind/rain sensor is connected, and instructions are in Czech. The setup screen password is 1.
Sorry, I don't speak Czech. Translating everything without understanding the program functions and custom blocks is challenging. I'm unable to help in this case.
I will work on translating the text, and the custom blocks are in the ZIP. Apologies for my limited English; I use Google Translate.
I am aware the custom blocks are in the ZIP file, but the project texts are also in Czech. Unfortunately, I do not know how the custom blocks are meant to function.
I will translate the text; give me a moment.
Take your time; for me, the workday is finished.
OK, thank you.

Hello ixo65, I tried translating the project. Language can be changed over M29, so maybe it's clearer. My issue is with the B127 Rain Sensitivity setting screen; the password is 1. On the setup screen, I want to adjust the set point value using the cursor key, which gets sent to the UP/DOWN counter B129 but does not update the B119 analog threshold trigger. In the simulation, this value is transferred, but on real hardware it is not. I need the CNT value from B129 to automatically switch ON in B119. Thank you

Transferring the value from 'B129 Ax' to 'B119 ON' functions as intended. If the B119 input exceeds the ON value, the threshold will activate; if below the OFF value, it will deactivate. I've verified this online using real hardware. The value from B129 is not shown online on B119 because it's referenced; you see the output value of B119 only.

Thank you for your help. Sorry for the confusion, everything works as intended. I mistakenly thought online mode would display the same as the simulation and both CNT and ON values would update in the block's field. I apologize and appreciate your help.
The cursor keys function on that screen or any custom screens made for the message text blocks.
The cursor keys can be used on that screen or any custom screens using message text blocks. User #dP is aware of this. However, it seems you did not understand what #dP intended to convey.

analysis.insight_summary: Users experienced differences between simulation and actual device behavior when connecting an UP/DOWN counter to an analog threshold trigger. The simulation performed as expected, while real hardware required special actions such as using cursor keys in specific screens. The core issue is the mismatch between virtual and real-world operation, particularly regarding user interface elements.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the physical device to mirror simulation functionality, desiring consistent UP/DOWN counter-to-threshold triggering across both environments, without needing extra steps or unique screen interactions.
